corm.definition: n. solid swollen underground bulb-shaped stem or stem base and serving as a reproductive structure

cormophyta.definition:
n. pl. A term proposed by Endlicher to include all plants
   with an axis containing vascular tissue and with foliage.

cormorant.definition: n. large voracious dark-colored long-necked seabird with a distensible pouch for holding fish; used in Asia to catch fish
cormorant.translation:
n. 鸬鹚, 贪婪的人
a. 贪婪的

cormorants.definition: n. large voracious dark-colored long-necked seabird with a distensible pouch for holding fish; used in Asia to catch fish
cormorants.translation: n. 鸬鹚, 贪婪的人( cormorant的复数形式 )

corms.definition:
plural of corm
n. solid swollen underground bulb-shaped stem or stem base and serving as a reproductive structure
corms.translation:
(corm 的复数) n. 球茎
[医] 球茎

cormus.definition:
n. See Corm.
n. A vegetable or animal made up of a number of individuals,
   such as, for example, would be formed by a process of budding from a
   parent stalk wherre the buds remain attached.
